Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TSLA.
Our cloud segment grew 5% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 5% to 7% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $36.2 billion this quarter, representing 5% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $36.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.33 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Revenue guidance of $36.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
